literal: That summer eastern Shandong had great floods; frogs croaked in trees.
idiomatic: That summer eastern Shandong flooded; frogs croaked in the trees.

literal: [13] Seventh month of autumn, day yihai: the state of Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: [13] On yihai day in the seventh month of autumn Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Grand mobile office Hou Jing and Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao besieged Baoju's general Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong; Baoju and Yuwen Heitu both came to rescue.
idiomatic: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, and Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, besieged Dugu Ruyuan, Baoju's general, at Jinyong; Baoju and Yuwen Heitu came to relieve him.

literal: Commander-in-chief Kudie Gan led the generals as vanguard; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) followed with the main host.
idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Kudie Gan led the vanguard; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) followed with the main army.

literal: Eighth month, day xinmao: battle at Heyin; they were greatly defeated.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, battle was joined at Heyin and the enemy was routed.

literal: Their commander-in-chief, equal-to-three-division commander Kou Luosheng and more than twenty others were beheaded; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.
idiomatic: More than twenty commanders including Kou Luosheng, equal to the Three Excellencies, were beheaded; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.

literal: Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao, Commander-in-chief Li Meng, and Song Xian all died in battle.
idiomatic: Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, Commander-in-chief Li Meng, and Song Xian all fell in battle.

literal: Baoju left his general Changsun Ziyan to hold Jinyong.
idiomatic: Baoju left Changsun Ziyan to hold Jinyong.

literal: Day renchen: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) crossed the river; Ziyan abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: On renchen day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) crossed the river; Ziyan abandoned the city and fled.

literal: Ninth month: Commander-in-chief Heba Ren attacked Xing Mo, Lu Zhongli, and others, defeated and pacified them.
idiomatic: In the ninth month Commander-in-chief Heba Ren attacked Xing Mo, Lu Zhongli, and the rest, defeated them, and pacified the region.

literal: Tenth month of winter: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: Lu Cao was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, Lu Cao was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: [14] Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court.
idiomatic: [14] Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court.

literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: he returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, he returned to Jinyang.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day dingchou: an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and grand mobile office; he firmly declined the grand chancellorship.
idiomatic: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and grand mobile office; he firmly declined the grand chancellorship.

literal: Eighth month, day renchen: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wang Yuanjing and Concurrent Direct-palace Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wei Shou were sent as envoys to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen day, Wang Yuanjing, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, and Wei Shou, concurrent direct-palace scattered cavalier attendant, were sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: one hundred thousand corvée laborers within the capital region were levied to wall Ye city; the work ended after forty days.
idiomatic: On jiazi day in the ninth month one hundred thousand laborers of the capital region were levied to wall Ye; the work ended in forty days.

literal: Day xinwei: a partial amnesty within the capital region for death crimes and below, each in differing measure.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the capital region received a graded partial amnesty through death crimes and below.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day guihai: because the new palace was completed, a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven and the era name was changed.
idiomatic: On guihai day in the eleventh month of winter, with the new palace complete, the realm was amnestied and the era name changed.

literal: Those eighty and above were given gauze caps and staffs; those seventy and above were given silk; those ill and disabled were given grain and silk.
idiomatic: Those eighty and above received gauze caps and staffs; those seventy and above received silk; the sick and disabled received grain and silk.

literal: Corvée laborers who built the walls were granted tax remission for one year.
idiomatic: Laborers who built the walls were granted one year's tax remission.

literal: Second year, first month of spring, day renshen: Grand Mentor Wei Jing was made grand preceptor; General of Agile Cavalry, Opening-office Equal-to-three-division Commander Kudie Gan was made grand mentor.
idiomatic: In the second year, on renshen day in the first month of spring, Wei Jing became grand preceptor and Kudie Gan, general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand mentor.

literal: Day dingchou: the court moved to the new palace; a general amnesty; civil and military officials within and without were all advanced one rank; chief builders were favored one rank beyond the rest.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court moved into the new palace, amnestied the realm, promoted every official one rank, and gave the chief builders an extra rank.

literal: Third month, day jimao: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month of summer, day jiyou: Western Wei grand mobile office Gong Yanhe and Inspector of Shaan Province Gong Yuanqing led their households in to submit; they were settled north of the Yellow River.
idiomatic: On jiyou day in the fifth month of summer, Gong Yanhe, Western Wei grand mobile office, and Gong Yuanqing, inspector of Shaan, led their households in and were settled north of the river.

literal: The newly submitted were relieved from the granaries in differing amounts.
idiomatic: The newly submitted were fed from the granaries in graded amounts.

literal: Day renzi: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Xiang was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: On renzi day Li Xiang, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Intercalary month, day jichou: the emperor's elder brother Jingzhi was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang; [15] younger brothers Wei Prince of Qinghe, Qian Prince of Yingchuan.
idiomatic: On jichou day in the intercalary month the emperor's elder brother Jingzhi was made prince of Yiyang; [15] younger brothers Wei, prince of Qinghe, and Qian, prince of Yingchuan.

literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Grand Marshal, Prince of Huashan Zhi died.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, Zhi, prince of Huashan and grand marshal, died.

literal: The text is deficient.
idiomatic: The text is deficient.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingwei: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingwei day in the tenth month of winter Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Cui Changqian was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Cui Changqian, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third year, second month of spring, day jiachen: Azheluo led the great chief Tuba Nahun's tribes in surrender.
idiomatic: In the third year, on jiachen day in the second month of spring, Azheluo led the great chief Tuba Nahun's tribes in surrender.

literal: Third month, day jiyou: Gongsun Guibin of Liang Province gathered a band and rebelled, styling himself Heavenly King.
idiomatic: On jiyou day in the third month Gongsun Guibin of Liang province raised a band and styled himself Heavenly King.

literal: The garrison commander of Yangxia campaigned against and captured him.
idiomatic: The Yangxia garrison commander captured him.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day wushen: Fufoluoyue Juzi Qubing of the Azheluo state came in surrender and was enfeoffed King of the Gaoche.
idiomatic: On wushen day in the fourth month of summer Fufoluoyue Juzi Qubing of Azheluo surrendered and was made king of the Gaoche.

literal: Sixth month, day yichou: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yichou day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day guimao: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) came to court from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao day, Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) came to court from Jinyang.

literal: Earlier, an edict had ordered Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) and the hundred ministers to debate and fix the new statutes at Linzhi Pavilion; on jiayin they were promulgated to all under Heaven.
idiomatic: Earlier an edict had ordered Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) and the ministers to fix the new statutes at Linzhi Pavilion; on jiayin they were promulgated throughout the realm.

literal: Day jisi: fifty thousand corvée laborers were levied to build the Zhang River embankment; the work ended after thirty-five days.
idiomatic: On jisi day fifty thousand laborers were levied to build the Zhang River embankment; the work ended in thirty-five days.

literal: Day guihai: the imperial carriage hunted on Western Mountain.
idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor hunted on Western Mountain.

literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: the court returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, the court returned to the palace.

literal: Day bingxu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Pengcheng Shao was made grand commander; Director of Revenue Hu Sengjing was made minister of works.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Shao, prince of Pengcheng and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand commander; Hu Sengjing, director of revenue, became minister of works.

literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth year, first month of spring, day bingchen: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingyin: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hui was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fourth month of summer Li Hui, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Day yiyou: Attendant-in-ordinary, Prince of Guangyang Zhan was made grand commander; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Longzhi was made minister over the masses; Grand Commander, Prince of Pengcheng Shao was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Zhan, prince of Guangyang and attendant-in-ordinary, became grand commander; Gao Longzhi, vice director of the Masters of Writing, became minister over the masses; Shao, prince of Pengcheng and grand commander, became recorder of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Day dinghai: Grand Preceptor Wei Jing, for an offense, was reduced to general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal-to-three-division commander.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Wei Jing, grand preceptor, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry with an opening office equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: Day xinmao: Grand Mentor Kudie Gan was made grand preceptor; Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao was made grand marshal; Zuyi was enfeoffed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Kudie Gan became grand preceptor, Lou Zhao, commander of the guards, grand marshal, and Zuyi was made vice director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court and requested that the hundred officials meet the emperor monthly to set forth government affairs, make known what is hidden and narrow, receive remonstrance and repel evil, personally judge lawsuits, and reward diligence and punish slackness;
idiomatic: On xinsi day in the fifth month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court and asked that officials meet the throne monthly to conduct government, bring hidden wrongs to light, accept remonstrance and drive off evil, judge cases in person, and reward the diligent while punishing the slack;

literal: if regional inspectors and prefects were at fault, ranks were to be reduced by stages with mutual liability;
idiomatic: regional inspectors and prefects who erred were to be punished by stages with mutual liability;

literal: within the inner quarters, consorts were to attend the ruler in order;
idiomatic: within the inner quarters consorts were to attend the ruler in proper order;

literal: hawks and dogs of the rear garden were all to be released.
idiomatic: and hawks and dogs of the rear garden were all to be released.

literal: Sixth month: he returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the sixth month he returned to Jinyang.

literal: Day bingshen: former Attendant-in-ordinary, Prince of Lelang Zhong's title was restored.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the title of Zhong, former attendant-in-ordinary and prince of Lelang, was restored.

literal: Day dingyou: the titles of Prince of Chenliu Jinghao, Prince of Changshan Shaozong, and Prince of Gaomi Yongye were restored.
idiomatic: On dingyou day the titles of Jinghao, prince of Chenliu, Shaozong, prince of Changshan, and Yongye, prince of Gaomi, were restored.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day gengxu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Director of Personnel Hou Jing was made concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Henan-route grand mobile office, campaigning and defending as circumstances required.
idiomatic: On gengxu day in the eighth month of autumn Hou Jing, opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies and director of personnel, became concurrent vice director and Henan-route grand mobile office, to campaign and defend as needed.

literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the Tuyuhun state all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth month of summer: Xi, younger brother of Prince of Pengcheng Shao, was enfeoffed Prince of Wu'an.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xi, younger brother of Shao, prince of Pengcheng, was made prince of Wu'an.

literal: Fifth month, day renchen: because Hulao had been recovered, prisoners under death sentence and below throughout the realm were released.
idiomatic: On renchen day in the fifth month, with Hulao recovered, prisoners through death crimes and below were released throughout the realm.

literal: Day yiwei: Director of Personnel Hou Jing was made minister of works.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Hou Jing, director of personnel, became minister of works.

literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day wuyin: former supernumerary scattered cavalier attendant Yuan Changchun was enfeoffed Prince of Nan Commandery.
idiomatic: On wuyin day Yuan Changchun, former supernumerary scattered cavalier attendant, was made prince of Nan commandery.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day yiwei: Inspector of Fen Province Hulu Jin was made grand marshal.
idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eighth month of autumn Hulu Jin, inspector of Fen, became grand marshal.

literal: Day renwu: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hun was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: On renwu day Li Hun, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: That month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) summoned fifty thousand corvée laborers at Northern Mountain in Xi Province to build a wall, west from Maling garrison east to Tuxian.
idiomatic: That month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) summoned fifty thousand laborers at Northern Mountain in Xi to build a wall from Maling garrison west to Tuxian east.

literal: The work ended after forty days.
idiomatic: The work ended in forty days.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day jiawu: the imperial carriage hunted on Western Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiawu day in the eleventh month of winter the emperor hunted on Western Mountain.

literal: Day yisi: the court returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On yisi day the court returned to the palace.

literal: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second year, first month of spring: the state of Didouyu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second year, first month of spring, Didouyu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month, day dingmao: Liu Wuhei of Xu Province gathered a band and rebelled.
idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao day, Liu Wuhei of Xu province raised a band in rebellion.

literal: Grand mobile office Murong Shaozong was sent to campaign against and pacify him.
idiomatic: Murong Shaozong, grand mobile office, was sent to suppress him.

literal: Third month: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Because of drought, prisoners under death sentence and below were pardoned.
idiomatic: Because of drought, prisoners through death crimes and below were pardoned.

literal: Day bingwu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander Sun Teng was made grand mentor.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Sun Teng, opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand mentor.

literal: Day renzi: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) was made grand general and concurrent attendant-in-ordinary; on civil and military duties, rewards and punishments, and the great statutes, he was to be consulted.
idiomatic: On renzi day Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) was made grand general and concurrent attendant-in-ordinary; civil and military appointments, rewards, punishments, and major regulations were referred to him.

literal: Director of the Secretariat Yuan Bi was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Left Vice Director Sima Ziru was made Director of the Masters of Writing; the Present Sovereign was made right vice director.
idiomatic: Yuan Bi, director of the secretariat, became recorder of the Masters of Writing; Sima Ziru, left vice director, became director; the Present Sovereign became right vice director.

literal: Fourth month of summer: the Shiwei state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wei Jijing was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: On jiawu day in the fifth month Wei Jijing, scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Day dingyou: Grand Commander, Prince of Guangyang Zhan died.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Zhan, prince of Guangyang and grand commander, died.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day guiyou: Director of the Masters of Writing Sima Ziru, for an offense, was removed from office.
idiomatic: On guiyou day in the eighth month of autumn Sima Ziru, director of the Masters of Writing, was dismissed for an offense.

literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Jiyin Huiye was made grand commander.
idiomatic: On jiashen day in the ninth month Huiye, prince of Jiyin and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand commander.

literal: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Xianyang Tan, for an offense was removed from office and returned to his residence.
idiomatic: Tan, prince of Xianyang and grand preceptor, was dismissed for an offense and sent home.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingsi: Grand Mentor Sun Teng and Grand Marshal Gao Longzhi were each made commissioners for registering households; [18] in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were recovered.
idiomatic: On dingsi day in the tenth month of winter Sun Teng, grand mentor, and Gao Longzhi, grand marshal, were each made commissioners for registering households; [18] in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were recovered.

literal: Eleventh month: the ground collapsed in Xihe and fire burst forth.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month the ground collapsed in Xihe and fire burst forth.

literal: Day jiashen: Minister over the Masses Gao Longzhi was made Director of the Masters of Writing; former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao was made minister over the masses.
idiomatic: On jiashen day Gao Longzhi, minister over the masses, became director of the Masters of Writing and Lou Zhao, former grand marshal, minister over the masses.

literal: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) went to Jinyang.

literal: Day gengzi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Round Mound.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the emperor performed rites at the Round Mound.

literal: Day xinchou: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day renyin: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) followed Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) in campaigning against the Mountain Hu, defeated them, and captured more than ten thousand households, who were distributed among the provinces.
idiomatic: On renyin day Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) followed Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) against the Mountain Hu, defeated them, and distributed more than ten thousand captive households among the provinces.

literal: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, Rouran, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third year, first month of spring, day bingshen: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Jiang was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the third year, on bingshen day in the first month of spring, Li Jiang, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Day dingwei: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) requested that a Jinyang palace be established at Bing Province to house confiscated dependents.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) asked that a Jinyang palace be built at Bing to house confiscated dependents.

literal: Second month, day gengshen: the Tuyuhun state presented a younger sister of the ruler to fill the rear quarters; she was received as Ronghua concubine.
idiomatic: On gengshen day in the second month Tuyuhun presented a younger sister of the ruler for the inner palace; she was received as Ronghua concubine.

literal: Fifth month of summer, day jiachen: a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.
idiomatic: On jiachen day in the fifth month of summer the realm was amnestied.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengzi: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day in the seventh month of autumn Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter: Secretariat Attendant Wei Jin was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Wei Jin, secretariat attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

literal: Day yiwei: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) requested captives from Mount Mang be released from fetters and paired with widows among the people.
idiomatic: On yiwei day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) asked that captives from Mount Mang be freed from bonds and matched with widows among the people.
